visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short dark hair, wearing an olive-green hoodie, sits outdoors at a black camping table. He is manipulating a small metallic pressure alcohol stove with his hands, while a silver kettle rests on a green Iwatani gas stove to his left. The background shows a translucent tent structure with green foliage visible outside. (2) The camera zooms in on the metallic stove, showcasing its intricate brass and copper piping and a small circular pressure gauge on the front. The man's hands are seen placing a metallic ring onto the device and adjusting various valves. (3) The man points to the pressure gauge and then uses a small plastic bottle to pour liquid into a preheating tray at the base of the stove. (4) The man holds a large red and black gas canister equipped with a torch head. He demonstrates the trigger mechanism, and a playful yellow caption appears on the screen. (5) The man uses the gas torch to heat the upper coils of the alcohol stove. Bright blue flames from the torch lick the copper pipes while the man's hands remain steady. (6) The torch is put away, and the man sits back to explain the stove's function. The silver kettle is moved from the gas stove to the alcohol stove. (7) The video ends with a comparison shot of the two stoves side-by-side on the table, with the man smiling and talking to someone off-camera.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 金屬風格 酒精氣化爐開箱. [Subtitle]: 新買的酒精爐. (2) [Subtitle]: 在家裡燒過一次而已. 還沒有出來用過. (3) [Subtitle]: 難怪我就沒看過. 妳沒看過東西可多了. (4) [Subtitle]: 你還敢講. 它其實是金屬. (5) [Subtitle]: 然後一個木頭盒. 妳看是不是很漂亮. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後它是用酒精. 但是它需要加壓. (7) [Subtitle]: 所以這邊要打氣. 但是它沒有內建打氣幫浦. (8) [Subtitle]: 欸這好像是我那個外公以前看醫生的時候. (9) [Subtitle]: 對對對 - 就是那個那個量血壓的. (10) [Subtitle]: 然後也很像那個以前人噴香水. (11) [Subtitle]: 所以它有一個很復古的一個打氣法. (12) [Subtitle]: 然後它這邊的話是用來看壓力. (13) [Subtitle]: 它雖然是酒精但還是要預熱. (14) [Subtitle]: 加一點酒精. 然後用我這一個來. (15) [Subtitle]: 妳給大家看這個. 很少用的巨型打火機. (16) [Subtitle]: 它其實是瓦斯噴槍. 它通常點火不是很慢嗎. (17) [Subtitle]: 這是具有像槍一樣的把手一點就著. (18) [Subtitle]: 一點就沒有著. [Variety]: (Ding sounds effect). (19) [Subtitle]: 它其實本來用的是高山瓦斯. 我把它轉成卡式的. 我先預熱一下. (20) [Subtitle]: 各位記得那個酒精在白天點燃是看不到火. (21) [Subtitle]: 所以摸溫度嗎. 對 我現在在... (22) [Subtitle]: 喔有了 有熱熱的了. 因為我現在燒的是藥用酒精啦. (23) [Subtitle]: 因為家裡很多庫存先把它燒一燒. (24) [Subtitle]: 藥用酒精含水率比較高,點比較慢,所以讓它先預熱一下. (25) [Subtitle]: 它聲音一般般,不是太小聲. (26) [Subtitle]: 是酒精爐的缺點幾乎看不到火. 好吧 來燒水吧. (27) [Subtitle]: 等一下 有點想問喔. [Variety]: 這邊就有瓦斯爐. (28) [Subtitle]: 你一定要燒酒精爐. 我就問問,搞那麼複雜. (29) [Subtitle]: 我那個瓦斯爐呢? [Variety]: 這怕低溫 - 喀噠喀噠. (30) [Subtitle]: 卡式瓦斯爐怕低溫,這個酒精爐不怕低溫. (31) [Subtitle]: 那今天就是一個低溫,雖然沒到下雪. (32) [Subtitle]: 但現在不用就沒機會用了. (33) [Subtitle]: 妳再不給我用,它就要放到明年冬天了.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, casual tone. Background music consisting of an upbeat acoustic guitar melody starts immediately. (2) A subtle metallic click is heard as the man adjusts the stove. A female voice is heard off-camera, engaging in a lighthearted dialogue. (3) The rhythmic strumming of the guitar remains consistent while the male explains the device's history. A sharp 'Ding' SFX occurs as a visual highlight is shown. (4) Frequent mechanical clicking sounds are heard as the man tries to ignite a gas torch, followed by the soft hiss of escaping gas and a 'whoosh' when it ignites. (5) The male voice continues to explain the preheating process over the steady BGM. The environment remains quiet with only the faint rustle of clothing and the crackle of the stove preheating.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator introduces and reviews a specialized vintage-style metallic pressure alcohol stove during a camping trip. He demonstrates its complex setup and preheating process while justifying its use in cold weather over traditional gas stoves through a conversational dialogue with an off-camera companion.
